title: Rotation Program Intervals and Visit Prices — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
**Rotation program, Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty.** Documented Crestline rotations are a condition of the treadwear adjustment on every line. A line sets the largest gap allowed between consecutive documented rotations (and from installation to the first rotation), the tolerance added to that gap, the price of each rotation visit and whether a matching full-size spare joins the pattern.

| Line | Largest rotation gap | Grace added to the gap | Rotation records required | Rotation-and-balance visit | Rotation-only visit | Full-size spare in the pattern |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Value Touring 40K Treadwear Warranty | 7,500 miles | 500 miles | Yes | $29.99 | $19.99 | No |
| Crestline All-Season 50K Treadwear Warranty | 7,500 miles | 500 miles | Yes | $0.00 | $0.00 | No |
| Crestline Grand Touring 60K Treadwear Warranty | 7,500 miles | 1,000 miles | Yes | $0.00 | $0.00 | No |
| Crestline Highway Terrain LT 65K Treadwear Warranty | 6,000 miles | 500 miles | Yes | $0.00 | $0.00 | Yes |
| Crestline Premium Touring 75K Treadwear Warranty | 7,500 miles | 1,000 miles | Yes | $0.00 | $0.00 | No |
| Crestline Ultra Touring 85K Treadwear Warranty | 7,500 miles | 1,000 miles | Yes | $0.00 | $0.00 | No |

In figures without separators: largest gaps 7500, 7500, 7500, 6000, 7500, 7500; grace 500, 500, 1000, 500, 1000, 1000 miles, in line order. A visit price of $0.00 means the service is included for the life of the tires; only the Crestline Value Touring 40K Treadwear Warranty line charges for rotation visits ($29.99 with balancing, $19.99 without).

**Largest allowed gap (hypothetical gaps):** on a line with a 7,500-mile gap and 500 miles of grace, a gap of 8,000 miles keeps the rotation requirement and a gap of 8,001 miles breaks it; with 1,000 miles of grace the limit is 8,500 miles; on the Highway Terrain LT 65K line the limit is 6,000 plus 500, or 6,500 miles.
